reading.text:
Unit: def Enlarged.initJoint (used through the standing filtration by Cor 3.6 and 25 more).
Paper: the filtration "generated by W, N and an independent initial sigma-field F_0" before
augmentation: F^raw_t = F_0 v sigma(W_s : s <= t) v sigma(N(B) : B measurable in [0,t] x E).
A faithful Lean definition: given G0 <= ambient sigma-algebra and the driver (W, N), the
filtration t |-> G0 v F^W_t v F^N_t (with F^W the joint natural filtration of the d coordinates
of W and F^N the natural filtration of the PRM), with G0 at every time. Independence of G0 is a
hypothesis of the setting, not part of the filtration. Not augmented, not right-continuous
(those belong to the usual augmentation, a separate definition).

comparison.text:
initJoint G0 D hG0 = D.filtration sup (Filtration.const R G0 hG0), i.e. (pointwise sup of
filtrations) t |-> (sup_i F^{W^i}_t) v F^N_t v G0, with D.filtration = W.naturalFiltration v
Poisson.naturalFiltration N (Driver/Joint.lean:66).
Matches the reading: G0 at every time, joint natural filtration of the d Brownian coordinates
and of the PRM, no augmentation, no right-continuity; independence is left to the statements.
Representation choice: R-indexed, and the natural filtrations include times s < 0, where the
library's Brownian motion is a.s. 0 and the PRM has zero intensity (reference intensity
Leb|[0,inf) x nu), so the extra sets are a.s. trivial; the definition is used only through its
null augmentation enlJoint, where they disappear.
Verdict: faithful with representation choices.

verdict.detail:
R-indexed filtration whose natural-filtration parts also contain sigma(W_s), s < 0, and
sigma(N(B)), B in negative times; these variables are a.s. constant (W_s = 0 a.s. for s < 0, the
PRM has zero intensity on negative times), so they add only sets of probability 0 or 1, which
the null augmentation in enlJoint (the only use) absorbs. Otherwise exactly
F_t = F^W_t v F^N_t v F_0.

author_review.disagreements:
No disagreement on substance. The author's review is an empty marker with no recorded
comparison; the representation choices listed in my detail are not recorded there.
